categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Matches the Utils/log/libs label and directly modifies src/logging.cpp to improve error handling for the logging infrastructure.
categories.rationale: It fixes unhandled `fclose()` failures during log rotation, shrinking, or shutdown by safely reporting writeback errors to stderr without re-entering the logger. While filesystem writeback failure on close is rare, ignoring it risks silent loss of diagnostics, providing a clear hygiene fix without being urgent.
